text: 据行业研究机构CRU Group称，随着全球供应反弹速度快于预期，铝价即将下跌。CRU预计，今年全球铝市将出现略低于50万吨的供应缺口，但随着中东冶炼厂恢复生产，以及中国和其他项目释放更多供应，明年和2028年将转为大幅过剩。铝价下跌对消费者而言将是利好，但可能对美国扩大国内铝产能的计划构成逆风，而数据中心和汽车行业是美国需求的亮点。
text_en: According to industry research firm CRU Group, aluminum prices are set to fall as global supply rebounds faster than expected. CRU expects a supply deficit of just under 500,000 metric tons in the global aluminum market this year, but a large surplus will emerge next year and in 2028 as Middle East smelters resume production and more supply comes online from China and other projects. Lower aluminum prices would be a boon for consumers but may pose headwinds to US plans to expand domestic aluminum capacity, while data centers and the auto sector are bright spots for US demand.
